identityTest.stableIdentity: A governed chart of accounts and its accounting-policy basis remain identifiable across account-version changes, hierarchy revisions, ledger adoption, recognition-rule changes and reporting periods.
identityTest.versionIdentity: Changes to taxonomy, hierarchy, permitted account mappings, recognition, measurement, currency or close policy create immutable revisions with explicit effective periods and predecessor lineage.

owns: permitted ledger-account classes and mapping rules
accounting-policy identity and recognition or measurement revisions
effective periods, adopting ledgers and governance approvals
cross-ledger mapping definitions and divergence semantics

references.purpose: Financial and ledger account identities governed by chart revisions
Journal entries and postings evaluated against effective policy
Time-bound balances and positions using declared derivation authority
Monetary, currency or rate context where applicable

excludes: source economic event, invoice or payment lifecycle
automatic accounting conclusion without effective policy and authority

invariants: Financial Account, Ledger Account, Chart, Accounting Policy, Journal Entry, Posting, source event and Position remain distinct identities.
Ledger account codes are interpreted only inside an effective ledger and chart revision.
Account code alone is never globally unique and never substitutes for ledger-account identity.
Every posting pins the ledger-account version and applicable policy revision effective on its accounting date.
Cross-ledger mappings express governed correspondence and divergence rather than arithmetic equality.
No chart or policy mapping permits debits and credits from different ledgers to balance each other.
Recognition and measurement changes create successor policy revisions and never rewrite posted history.
Hard-close and exception rules are effective-dated and every exception cites authorization.
Chart hierarchy revisions preserve predecessor paths and historical account interpretation.
Balances remain as-of assertions with derivation authority and never become chart facts.
Adoption by a ledger is explicit, effective-dated and independently revocable.
Retired chart and policy identifiers and all revisions remain resolvable and are never recycled.
holds: Registry namespace and identifier allocation are pending and no identifier may be guessed.
Accounting-regime profiles, immutable pins and currency crosswalks require frozen audit.
Package conversion and live verification are pending.
